judge.rationale: The production fix in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` is functionally sound, wrapping non-Error rejections in an `Error` with `{cause: error}` and safely guarding against unstringifiable values like `Object.create(null)`. However, in `onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts`, the candidate never actually asserts that `seenError.cause` equals the thrown string or plain object, missing an explicit part of the first two acceptance criteria in the test assertions (even though the production code sets it). Furthermore, while the reference added a single table-driven test directly to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, the candidate created four new test/fixture files in `src/orchestration/`, left `.lore/dod.md` in the tree, and made an unrelated modification to `scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs`. Finally, for plain object descriptions, the reference prefers `JSON.stringify` before falling back to `String(error)`, whereas the candidate uses `String(error)` directly (producing `"[object Object]"`).
